Anchor must not be one of the pair itself; retain actual anchor unitID/bbox and measured errors/flow in bounded proof; no semantic actor/subject/text borrowed.

Multicolumn/merged/ambiguous source geometry cannot become authoritative body-band proof through equal missing labels. If there is no trustworthy witness, report unknown/defer rather than fake a column.
Band height need not satisfy the terminal-tail line-height test, but the anchor must be ordinary native body geometry with valid layout/source provenance, not a heading/table/wide merged carrier.
